about_the_game:
In the demo, you can:

  • Play solo or with friends to co-manage your card shop.

  • Unlock and stock items to expand your inventory.

  • Open card packages and test the game’s trading mechanics.

This gives players a taste of the core gameplay while letting them explore the features before diving into the full experience.


👥 Play Solo or With Friends
Team up with friends or jump into public lobbies to co-manage your shop. Share tasks, split profits, and grow together.

🏪 Build and Manage Your Card Shop
Design your shop, restock inventory, decorate your space, and upgrade as your customer base grows. Every choice affects your profit.

📦 Hunt and Trade Rare Cards
Trade with other players and negotiate with quirky NPCs. Rare cards are out there—if you can spot them before the price spikes!

💬 Negotiate With Customers
Each customer has a personality. Some are cheapskates, others nostalgic—use your charm or stand firm to get the best deal.

📈 Track Prices & Market Trends
Card values change based on rarity, hype, and demand. Stay updated and make smart trades to win big.

🛒 Stock Vending Machines
Unlock and customize vending machines to sell items passively. Set prices, fill them with boosters or single cards, and watch the coins roll in!

🎒 Steam Inventory Integration
All cards and items are integrated with Steam Inventory. Own, trade, or showcase your collection across supported games.

🚚 Supply Runs & Backroom Logistics
Manage stock levels, refill your shelves, and keep the supply chain flowing. Don’t let your shop go empty during peak hours!

📈 Grow Your Card Empire
Reinvest your earnings into better gear, unlock advanced tools, and rise from rookie shopkeeper to TCG tycoon.

short_description: Run a TCG card shop with your friends! Trade, collect, and sell cards. Build your dream store, hunt for rares, and become the ultimate card dealer. A cozy multiplayer simulator made for trading card game lovers.
